summary: Frontend E2E of iteration 2 (collaborators RBAC + email reminders) on FinDash CRM. Verified: admin sees 'Collaboratori' nav (data-testid=nav-collaboratori) while collaborator does NOT; admin created a new collaborator via dialog (name/email/password + per-company Select role-select-<cid>), card appeared with correct role badges (Solo lettura + Modifica); admin edited membership (viewer -> editor) and deletion removed the card; collaborator (mario.rossi@example.org) sees only cmp_001 (Rossi, viewer) + cmp_002 (Bianchi, editor) in company-selector - cmp_003 is hidden; on Fatture, Rossi (viewer) shows 14 rows with 0 mark-paid & 0 send-reminder buttons (correctly gated by canWrite), Bianchi (editor) shows 15 rows with 5 write-action pairs; 'Tutte le aziende' view shows 29 rows and only 5 write pairs (Bianchi only) - matches RBAC. Admin clicked Sollecita on unpaid invoice: POST /api/invoices/{id}/send-reminder -> 200 with body 'Sollecito inviato via email a lorello97@gmail.com' and Italian success toast rendered. Cleanup: deleted TEST_ collaborators; admin (lorello97@gmail.com) and mario.rossi collaborator preserved.

issues: Route is not client-side protected. A collaborator visiting /collaboratori directly still renders the page shell with the 'Nuovo collaboratore' button and empty list (GET /collaborators returns 403 silently caught, so no data leak). Recommendation: hide route or redirect non-admin users in the router / show an 'Accesso negato' state.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Protect /collaboratori route in the frontend router (admin-only guard) so non-admins are redirected instead of seeing an empty admin page.

OPTIONAL: The DEV-only webpack-dev-server-client-overlay iframe appears on ResizeObserver warnings from Recharts and intercepts clicks in Playwright. Not visible to end users but blocks automation; consider silencing via CRA overlay config or ignoring the warning in code.
critical_code_review_comments: Collaboratori.jsx renders unconditionally; add role check (user?.role === 'admin') to avoid confusing UI for collaborators arriving via direct URL.
Fatture 'Tutte le aziende' view already gates buttons via canWrite(i.company_id) which is correct; server.py also enforces via require_write/scoped_filter (curl-verified).
CompanyContext silently swallows /companies failure - consider a toast for real failures (currently OK because backend seeds are stable).
